---
title: "Freehand AI assessment"
---

Students solve problems on paper, upload a photo of their working and get AI
feedback in four steps, from an assessment to a worked solution. Each problem
also has an answer field that is checked automatically.

- **Physics:** [Practice exam V2025](pages/handwriting-ai.qmd) (English) ·
  [Prøveeksamen V2025](pages/handskrift-ki.qmd) (bokmål)
- **Mathematics:** [Logarithms, exam V24](pages/logarithms-ai.qmd) (English) ·
  [Logaritmer, eksamen V24](pages/logaritmer-ki.qmd) (bokmål)
- [Playing with the prompts](pages/handwriting-ai-prompts.qmd) (English) ·
  [Spill med promptene](pages/handskrift-ki-prompter.qmd) (bokmål), for teachers.
  Each exam page has its own prompts.
